capabilities: Replace selected text with its translation via right-click
Configure source and target languages in a settings window
Open the translation settings from a left sidebar icon
extras: README is bilingual (English and Portuguese); Git is only required for manual installation from the GitHub repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, so users must leave the editor or copy text to an external tool to translate it.
summary: Translation plugin that replaces selected text in the editor with its translation across 100+ languages.
